meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.

94%. That's a machine's guess, and the company that sells it says in its own guide that it shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student. Your school's procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern, so what else do you have, or am I going upstairs?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn and that I receive an apology for the zero being entered before anyone contacted me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: the opening position, agreeing to nothing and still wanting the zero withdrawn and an apology, with a trip to the principal ready if she doesn't get them.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero", because it rested the whole decision on a detector score she can dismiss with the vendor's own guidance and the school's procedure.
Try next time: in your first line, own that the zero went into the gradebook before you called her, then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her instead of the score.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
